responsibility: This script generates the mips-tables.opt option-table fragment from mips-cpus.def. It emits the Enum and EnumValue records used by GCC’s option machinery for -march=, -mtune=, and -mips values, reproducing GAS-compatible CPU-name aliases such as numeric, r-prefixed, vr/rm-prefixed, and trailing-000-to-k variants, so it is the build-time bridge from the canonical CPU list to the generated MIPS option enums.
